description: Crypto news from 8 newsrooms (CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block, Bitcoin Magazine, The Defiant, Blockworks, Bitcoin.com) in one call, newest first, with the coins each story names. Filter by coin, text or since. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

coin.description: only stories naming this coin, e.g. BTC

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

since.description: only stories published after this time (ISO or unix seconds)

name: crypto_news
